newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks steady after soft opening.
newsitem.headline: French stocks steady after soft opening.

text.p: French shares regained positive ground to trade around the 2,600 level on Monday, after retracing opening losses. Traders said the market was supported by Wall Street gains last Friday and continued dollar strength.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was up 2.88 points or 0.11 percent at 2,600.40 at 0922 GMT while the CAC-40 futures contract was up at 2,609 from 2,601 on Friday's close.
Insurer Axa among most active stocks, up 1.85 percent.
* Oils were also busy, with profit-taking on Elf Aquitaine down 1.55 percent at 573 francs and Total down 0.62 percent.
Retailer Promodes rises 2.05 percent, after posting 1996 sales in line or slightly better than expected. Retailing stocks have potential for catching up, said a broker.

Cie Generale des Eaux flat, Havas rises after last week's news of a capital restructuring between the two groups, which makes Havas the dominant shareholder in pay-television company Canal Plus. Canal Plus edges higher.
